clue.text: Evasive about mostly isolated settlement

indicators.note: the word for evasive is placed around the other piece, as about here means surrounding

parts.note: an evasive person is coy, unwilling to commit

indicators.note: mostly signals that the synonym loses its final letter, keeping most of it

parts.note: isolated means lone, standing alone

explanation.surface: A remote settlement whose people are cagey about their isolation.
explanation.definitionFit: A colony is a group of settlers established in a new territory, a kind of settlement.

clue.text: Fish the Thames perhaps with rally partner

parts.note: the cod is a common food fish
the Thames is an example of a river

explanation.surface: Someone goes fishing on the Thames with a companion.
explanation.definitionFit: In rallying, the co-driver sits beside the driver reading pace notes and navigating.

clue.text: Cattle for example survive on stored supplies

parts.note: to survive is to live on
stock is goods held in store

explanation.surface: Farm animals get through the winter on stored feed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word joining the two pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Livestock means farm animals, of which cattle are an example.

clue.text: Kelvin ran over informer

indicators.note: over in a down clue means the word for ran is turned upside down, read backwards

parts.note: K is the symbol for the kelvin, the unit of temperature

explanation.surface: A man named Kelvin knocks down a police informer with his car.
explanation.walkthrough: Kelvin looks like a man's name driving a car, but it is the temperature unit; in a down answer 'over' means turned upward.
explanation.definitionFit: Nark is British slang for a police informer or snitch.

clue.text: Large glass vessel

definitions.meaning: a tall beer or sherry glass of generous size
a sailing ship with two or more masts rigged fore and aft

explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a large drinking glass and a fore-and-aft rigged sailing ship.

clue.text: Dances madly round low lights

indicators.note: round means the jumbled letters are wrapped around the low letter
madly suggests the letters of the word before it go wild and rearrange

explanation.surface: People dance wildly around dim lamps at a party.
explanation.walkthrough: 'madly' rearranges DANCES, and 'round' puts it around L.
explanation.definitionFit: Candles are wax sticks with wicks, burned to give light.

clue.text: Several deliveries appeared to be missed

parts.note: in cricket an over is a set of six balls bowled by one bowler
appeared, as in seemed, means looked

explanation.surface: Several parcels apparently went undelivered.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a delivery is a single ball bowled; six make an over. 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Something overlooked has been missed or failed to be noticed.

clue.text: Sounds like experience? Not at all

indicators.note: sounds like means the letters entered match the pronunciation of a word for experience

parts.note: experience or practical skill is know-how

explanation.surface: Someone asks whether one thing resembles experience and gets a flat no.
explanation.definitionFit: Nohow is dialect for in no way whatever.

clue.text: About to arrange where to holiday

parts.note: re is Latin for concerning, about
to sort is to arrange in order

explanation.surface: People are about to plan where to go on holiday.
explanation.definitionFit: A resort is a place people visit for holidays and recreation.

clue.text: Well-built girl is marrying illegally

parts.note: a well-built person is big
Amy is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A strapping young woman is wedding unlawfully.
explanation.definitionFit: Bigamy is the crime of wedding someone while still lawfully wed to another.

clue.text: Underwater explorers working on island for amusement

indicators.note: in an across answer, on means placed after, so the word for working follows the island letter

parts.note: people who explore under the sea are divers
a machine that is working is on

explanation.surface: Scuba divers on holiday at an island find their entertainment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for' is a link word joining wordplay to definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A diversion is a pastime or entertainment that takes the mind off other things.

clue.text: Those changed people's character and attitudes

indicators.note: changed tells the solver the letters of the word before it are rearranged

explanation.surface: Those people whose character and outlook have shifted over time.
explanation.definitionFit: Ethos is the distinctive spirit and values of a community or culture.

clue.text: In short, this month isn't unusual

indicators.note: unusual suggests the letters of the word beside it are put in an odd order

explanation.surface: A remark that, briefly, nothing about this month is out of the ordinary.
explanation.walkthrough: The apostrophe in isn't is ignored, leaving four letters to rearrange.
explanation.definitionFit: Inst., short for instant, is old business-letter shorthand meaning of the current month.

clue.text: Colourful plant with everything found initially further down

parts.note: everything means all

indicators.note: initially picks out only the opening letter of the word it follows

parts.note: further down means lower

explanation.surface: A bright bloom grows with all the others lower down the garden bed.
explanation.definitionFit: The wallflower is a cottage-garden plant with bright yellow, orange or red flowers.

clue.text: Sailor and salesman said it contains seasoning

indicators.note: said means the entry is pronounced like the words for sailor and salesman

parts.note: a salt is an old sailor and a seller is a salesman

explanation.surface: A sailor and a salesman talk about seasoning.
explanation.definitionFit: A salt-cellar is a small dish or shaker holding table salt for flavouring food.

clue.text: Former husband may go off, marrying outside the tribe

parts.note: an ex is a former spouse

indicators.note: off suggests the words beside it go wrong and their letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: An ex-husband might wander off and wed someone from outside his clan.
explanation.definitionFit: Exogamy is the anthropological term for the custom of taking a spouse from beyond one's own group.

clue.text: Put an end to hard liquor

definitions.meaning: to quash or stamp out something, such as a rumour

explanation.surface: Someone vows to stop drinking strong spirits.
explanation.definitionFit: To scotch a rumour is to stamp it out; Scotch is also whisky, a hard spirit.

clue.text: What's on the floor? Slating

definitions.meaning: a severe reprimand or harsh criticism

explanation.definitionFit: Carpeting is floor covering, and a carpeting is also a dressing-down, like a slating.

clue.text: Persuade prisoner to take French wine to church

parts.note: con is short for convict, a prisoner
vin is the French word for wine
CE is the Church of England

explanation.surface: A prisoner is talked into taking French wine along to church.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to take' and 'to' are link words ordering the pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: To convince someone is to talk them round to believing or doing something.

clue.text: Draw second boat

parts.note: a ketch is a two-masted sailing boat

explanation.surface: An artist is asked to draw a second boat.
explanation.definitionFit: To sketch is to draw roughly and quickly.

clue.text: Keeps his heroin and another drug

parts.note: keeps means has, holds onto
H is slang for heroin

explanation.surface: A dealer keeps his heroin alongside a further narcotic.
explanation.definitionFit: Hashish is cannabis resin, a narcotic.

clue.text: Here, IOC are involved. Goodbye!

indicators.note: involved suggests the letters are tangled together into a new order

explanation.surface: The International Olympic Committee turns up here, and someone bids farewell.
explanation.walkthrough: IOC is the International Olympic Committee; its letters join those of HERE in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Cheerio is an informal British farewell, like bye.

clue.text: Caught boyfriend grazing

parts.note: C is the cricket abbreviation for caught
a boyfriend is a lover

explanation.surface: A girlfriend caught her boyfriend lying in the meadow.
explanation.definitionFit: Clover is a meadow plant grown as forage for grazing livestock.

clue.text: Cry is a source of amusement

definitions.meaning: something hilarious, as in it was a riot

explanation.definitionFit: A scream is a piercing cry, and informally a very funny person or thing.

clue.text: Vote against adaptation and change

parts.note: a con is a vote or argument against, as in pros and cons
an adaptation of a work is a version of it

explanation.surface: A committee rejects a proposed adaptation and other alterations.
explanation.definitionFit: A conversion is a transformation from one form or use into another.

clue.text: Number 100 is unacceptable

parts.note: a ton is slang for a hundred

explanation.surface: Bus number 100 is not good enough.
explanation.definitionFit: Not on is British idiom for not permissible or out of order.

clue.text: This fuel is very revolutionary all round

indicators.note: all round tells the solver the word for revolutionary is turned back to front

parts.note: a revolutionary is a red, a communist

clue.text: Couple level about top of incline

indicators.note: about places the word for level around the selected letter

parts.note: par means equal or level, as in on a par

indicators.note: top of in a down clue picks out the first letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A pair of hikers level off near the top of a slope.
explanation.definitionFit: A pair is two people or things together.

clue.text: Praise previous group's backing

parts.note: ex means former or previous

indicators.note: backing tells the solver the word for group is read in reverse

parts.note: a lot is a group or batch of things; the possessive stands for is

explanation.surface: A band praises the support it got from its previous members.
explanation.definitionFit: To extol is to laud something highly.

clue.text: Repeating it on English allotment

parts.note: an allotment is a ration, a share allocated

explanation.surface: Someone keeps going on about English allotment gardens.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on' is a link word placing the pieces in order.
explanation.definitionFit: Iteration is the act of doing or saying something again and again.

clue.text: Form of government working between March and end of May

indicators.note: between places the word for working inside the remaining letters, splitting the month's name

parts.note: taken as the month's name itself
a device that is working is on

indicators.note: end of picks out the final letter of the word that follows

explanation.surface: A government's work runs from March until late May.
explanation.definitionFit: Monarchy is rule by a king or queen, one kind of political system.

clue.text: Accent the shoe

definitions.meaning: a strong regional accent, especially Irish or Scottish
a stout leather shoe with decorative perforations

explanation.definitionFit: Brogue names both a lilting Irish or Scots accent and a sturdy patterned leather shoe.
